}}'''Primitive Tozoons''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] Tier.
==''Spawning''==
*Spawns after a successful merging between 4 [[Moving Flesh]], through the [[Evolution System]].
*Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
*Spawned by 4 [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]] stored into a [[Stage III Dispatcher|Stage III]] or [[Stage IV Dispatcher|IV Dispatcher]].
==''Behavior''==
Primitive Tozoons are Fast-Burrowing Melee Combatants. They are able to burrow underground to ambush their prey, they are completely invulnerable while underground.

* Primitive Tozoons' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Primitive Tozoons are able to perform small leaps in liquids.
* Primitive Tozoons are able to sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.

* They are able to teleport while underground, but the following conditions must be met:
** There must be 3 blocks below its current position, and in the position where it will teleport to.
** Those 3 blocks, in both positions, need to be full blocks.
** The sum of the 3 blocks' [[hardness]] values must be less than 10.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Primitive Tozoons, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Primitive Tozoons, while moving underground, if coming in contact with Magma Blocks they will start to be hurt.

==''Trivia''==

* Tozoons are referred to internally as "Wymo".
* The Primitive Tozoon has a unique spawn item compared to other Primitive Parasites, resembling the spawn item of Deterrents instead.
